messages.en:
Care to join me for a
little fishing expedition,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
You know, if you put some
fish in your room,{01 00 00 05 00} it's like
having a private aquarium!

Kas sa tahaksid minuga
väiksele kalaretkele,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
Tead, kui sa paned kalu
oma tuppa,{01 00 00 05 00} on see nagu
omaenda akvaarium!

messages.en:
I cast out my line.
Water rippling outward,
I wait for a bite.
I love fishing. I feel like a
lonely girl, waiting for my
lost love to return. {01 00 00 0a 00}Or{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
for {ff 00 00 07}{04 1a 00}
{ff 00 00 00}to bite.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Right now, I'll

I{01 00 00 05 00} loooove fishing, but
I just can't catch anything.

Maybe I ought to change

messages.en:
It's so nice to take some
time, relax, and cast my
line, isn't it, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 14 00}It's not about catching
something. It's about
enjoying life,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 02 00}!
messages.et:
On nii tore võtta aega,
lõõgastuda ja õng välja
visata, kas pole, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 14 00}Asi pole püüdmises.
Asi on elu
nautimises,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 02 00}!

messages.en:
I didn't used to be so into
fishing, but once I got
started, I couldn't stop.
I guess you might say I'm
hooked, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
Ma polnud varem nii suur
kalapüügihuviline, aga kui
alustasin, ei saanud pidama.
Võib öelda, et ma olen
konksu otsas, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
Whatever you do, don't
panic and just yank in your
line!
That's exactly what the
fish WANT you to do,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
You have to relax and
take it easy.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} The secret
is to keep your cool.
messages.et:
Mida iganes sa teed, ära
sattu paanikasse ja tõmba
õnge järsult!
Just seda kalad TAHAVAD,
et sa teeksid,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Sa pead lõõgastuma ja
rahulikult võtma.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Saladus
on külma närvi hoidmine.
